# Rajav Resort - Premium Coastal Luxury

Rajav Resort is a high-end coastal getaway located in Cherai, Kochi, Kerala. It offers a blend of natural beauty, refined elegance, and modern luxury facilities.

## Key Features
- **Infinity Pool**: Stunning views of the Arabian Sea.
- **Direct Beach Access**: Seamless access to the pristine sands of Cherai Beach.
- **Accommodation**:
    - **Premium Jacuzzi Suites**: Luxury rooms with private jacuzzis and beach views.
    - **Premium Beach View Rooms**: Panoramic ocean views and luxury amenities.
    - **Medium Balcony Rooms**: Comfortable stays with scenic streetscape balconies.
    - **Economy Rooms**: Budget-friendly luxury with full resort access.
- **Amenities**: High-speed WiFi, infinity pool, complimentary breakfast (premium), and secure parking.

## Location
- Address: Cherai Beach, Kochi, Kerala 683514, India.
- Setting: Coastal beachfront property.

## Booking Information
- Real-time availability tracking for all room categories.
- Secure online booking via the official website.
- URL: https://www.rajavbeachresort.com/
